name: Pitch
tagline: Pitch is a collaborative presentation platform for design-forward teams that want more polish and less friction than Google Slides. Its AI assistant generates complete slide decks from a prompt, and real-time collaboration features mean a whole team can work on the same deck simultaneously with live cursors. Startups and agencies use Pitch to create investor decks and client presentations that stand out.
